story.title: OTP Login
story.description: As a customer, I want OTP login so I can securely access my account.
story.business_value: Customers can access accounts safely without passwords.

acceptance_criteria: Given a valid phone number, when OTP is requested, then an OTP is sent.
Given a valid OTP, when submitted before expiry, then the customer is authenticated.

tasks.title: Build OTP login form
tasks.description: Create the phone number and OTP entry experience.

tasks.title: Validate OTP authentication
tasks.description: Implement OTP submit, expiry, and retry handling.
